dict.string: Kordi reads calendars you select to import events into your private digest. It does not send invitations.
When you turn on Calendar and Reminders in Connectors, your agent can read your reminders on this Mac when you ask. Kordi does not store them.
When you turn on Contacts in Connectors, Kordi asks Contacts for the people that match your agent's search on this Mac. Kordi does not store them.
Kordi uses your camera when you record a video message or join a video call.
Kordi uses your microphone when you record a voice or video message or join a call.
Kordi transcribes voice messages on this Mac so people and agents can read them.
